title: A Man Fell From 24 Miles Up and Broke the Sound Barrier

scenes.text: A man broke the sound barrier with no engine.
In October 2012, Felix Baumgartner rode a balloon to 24 miles up.
He stepped off in nothing but a pressure suit.
Air that high is so thin, he sped up and up for four minutes and 19 seconds.
He hit 843 miles an hour, Mach 1.25.
The first human to go supersonic with no engine at all.

description:
A man broke the sound barrier with no engine.
On October 14, 2012, Felix Baumgartner jumped from a balloon about 24 miles up and reached an estimated 843.6 miles an hour, Mach 1.25, in freefall.
Would you ever step off that ledge? Comment below.
first_comment: At that altitude the air is too thin for a parachute to slow you at first. Would you jump, yes or no?
